title: Correct three stale status lines in ROADMAP.md
problem: ROADMAP.md says this repository is an unpublished local candidate, that the Agent SKILL is not published, and that permit issuance returns 503. All three are false: the repository has been public since 2026-10-27, https://ailn.ai/SKILL.md returns 200, and the pre-mint gate answers 403 before the origin's 503. A roadmap that overstates is worse than none, and this one understates - either way readers build on wrong facts.
deliverables: ROADMAP.md with the three lines corrected
A one-line note in the PR body giving the evidence for each correction
acceptance: No sentence in ROADMAP.md still calls this repository unpublished
No sentence still says the SKILL is not published
The permit line states 403 at the gate and 503 at the origin, in that order

required: pasted output of npm run verify
the HTTP status code you observed for the SKILL URL
